name: Annual Notice of Right to Opt Out of Recruiter Disclosure
description: Annual notice of the right to request that student information not be released to postsecondary institutions or military recruiters; Attachment A may be used.
quote: The building principal or designee shall annually notify parents/guardians, and students who have reached eighteen (18) years of age, of the right to request that student information not be released to representatives of postsecondary institutions and/or military recruiters without prior written consent.
